title: Learn AI. Build something that matters.

segments.source: Learn artificial intelligence. Build projects that matter. Find your people. That’s Saturdays.AI.
segments.en: Learn artificial intelligence. Build projects that matter. Find your people. That’s Saturdays.AI.

segments.source: You don’t need to have it all figured out.
segments.en: You don’t need to have it all figured out.

segments.source: Just bring a question and a little curiosity.
segments.en: Just bring a question and a little curiosity.
segments.es: Solo una pregunta y un poco de curiosidad.

segments.source: No perfect background required. Find a learning path, get hands-on and turn “what if” into your first project.
segments.en: No perfect background required. Find a learning path, get hands-on and turn “what if” into your first project.
segments.es: No hay un perfil ideal para empezar. Encuentra tu itinerario, pasa a la práctica y convierte un «¿y si…?» en tu primer proyecto.

segments.source: Make AI work for the world around you. Explore community projects and find the spark for your next idea.
segments.en: Make AI work for the world around you. Explore community projects and find the spark for your next idea.
segments.es: Aplica la IA a lo que te rodea. Explora proyectos de la comunidad y encuentra inspiración para tu próxima idea.

segments.source: Learning is better together. Meet curious minds, share what you know and grow with your local community.
segments.en: Learning is better together. Meet curious minds, share what you know and grow with your local community.
segments.es: Aprender en compañía es mejor. Conoce a personas curiosas, comparte lo que sabes y crece con tu comunidad local.

segments.source: From your first line of Python to generative AI. Pick a topic, learn at your own pace and put it into practice.
segments.en: From your first line of Python to generative AI. Pick a topic, learn at your own pace and put it into practice.
segments.es: Desde tu primera línea de Python hasta la IA generativa. Elige un tema, aprende a tu ritmo y ponlo en práctica.

segments.source: Real challenges are the best classroom. Explore how our community applies AI to the environment, health and everyday life.
segments.en: Real challenges are the best classroom. Explore how our community applies AI to the environment, health and everyday life.
segments.es: Los retos reales son la mejor escuela. Descubre cómo nuestra comunidad aplica la IA al medioambiente, la salud y la vida cotidiana.

segments.source: Meet learners, builders and mentors in a city near you. There is room for different backgrounds and fresh perspectives.
segments.en: Meet learners, builders and mentors in a city near you. There is room for different backgrounds and fresh perspectives.
segments.es: Conoce a estudiantes, personas creadoras y mentores cerca de ti. Aquí caben trayectorias diversas y nuevas perspectivas.

segments.source: We’re a non-profit community on a mission to make AI accessible to anyone. Students, career changers, researchers, makers. Different starting points, shared curiosity.
segments.en: We’re a non-profit community on a mission to make AI accessible to anyone. Students, career changers, researchers, makers. Different starting points, shared curiosity.
segments.es: Somos una comunidad sin ánimo de lucro que quiere acercar la IA a todas las personas. Estudiantes, profesionales que cambian de rumbo, investigadores y creadores. Distintos puntos de partida, la misma curiosidad.

segments.source: Through AI Saturdays, we learn by building projects with social impact, supported by people who want to see each other grow.
segments.en: Through AI Saturdays, we learn by building projects with social impact, supported by people who want to see each other grow.
segments.es: En AI Saturdays aprendemos creando proyectos con impacto social y nos apoyamos para crecer en comunidad.

segments.source: At Saturdays.AI we believe that AI provides a set of tools that everyone should have access to. We hold that diversity enhances creativity.
segments.en: At Saturdays.AI we believe that AI provides a set of tools that everyone should have access to. We hold that diversity enhances creativity.
segments.es: En Saturdays.AI creemos que la IA proporciona un conjunto de herramientas a las que todos deberían tener acceso. Sostenemos que la diversidad mejora la creatividad.

segments.source: Our mentors will guide your learning and are focused on answering your questions, motivating you and keeping you on track.
segments.en: Our mentors will guide your learning and are focused on answering your questions, motivating you and keeping you on track.
segments.es: Nuestros mentores guiarán tu aprendizaje y se centrarán en responder tus preguntas, motivarte y mantenerte encaminado.

segments.source: The learning of the future increasingly takes place in communities. We connect a global community of AI students.
segments.en: The learning of the future increasingly takes place in communities. We connect a global community of AI students.
segments.es: El aprendizaje del futuro tiene lugar cada vez más en las comunidades. Conectamos una comunidad global de estudiantes de IA.

segments.source: You can use AI to solve social problems, such as climate change, education, disease diagnosis or local problems in your city, but it can also be misused.
segments.en: You can use AI to solve social problems, such as climate change, education, disease diagnosis or local problems in your city, but it can also be misused.
segments.es: Puedes utilizar la IA para resolver problemas sociales, como el cambio climático, la educación, el diagnóstico de enfermedades o problemas locales en tu ciudad, pero también se puede hacer un mal uso.

segments.source: We are a non-profit community on a mission to make AI accessible to anyone.
segments.en: We are a non-profit community on a mission to make AI accessible to anyone.
segments.es: Somos una comunidad sin fines de lucro con la misión de hacer que la IA sea accesible para todos.

segments.source: We connect individuals and organizations through communities to create social impact. Our flagship programme,

segments.source: is suitable for anyone that wants to start in AI, learning by doing AI projects with social impact in their community.
segments.en: is suitable for anyone that wants to start in AI, learning by doing AI projects with social impact in their community.
segments.es: es adecuado para cualquier persona que quiera iniciarse en la IA, aprendiendo realizando proyectos de IA con impacto social en su comunidad.

segments.source: Altogether with the support of an awesome community of people who, like you, love to learn AI and apply it for the betterment of our world.
segments.en: Altogether with the support of an awesome community of people who, like you, love to learn AI and apply it for the betterment of our world.
segments.es: Todo ello con el apoyo de una increíble comunidad de personas a las que, como tú, les encanta aprender sobre IA y aplicarla para mejorar nuestro mundo.

segments.source: Participating in Saturdays, as a student, mentor, volunteer or staff, have helped many individuals to advance their careers and achieve some reasonable happiness, by working and researching in some of the leading AI organizations worldwide, as well as start their own AI business, or join an industry where to apply their skills.
segments.en: Participating in Saturdays, as a student, mentor, volunteer or staff, have helped many individuals to advance their careers and achieve some reasonable happiness, by working and researching in some of the leading AI organizations worldwide, as well as start their own AI business, or join an industry where to apply their skills.
segments.es: Participar en los sábados, como estudiante, mentor, voluntario o personal, ha ayudado a muchas personas a avanzar en sus carreras y lograr una felicidad razonable, trabajando e investigando en algunas de las principales organizaciones de IA en todo el mundo, así como a iniciar su propio negocio de IA o unirse a una industria donde aplicar sus habilidades.
Conozca a nuestros becarios de IA

segments.source: Saturdays.AI offers free online courses with a roadmap to get yourself started in the world of AI.
segments.en: Saturdays.AI offers free online courses with a roadmap to get yourself started in the world of AI.
segments.es: Saturdays.AI ofrece cursos en línea gratuitos con una hoja de ruta para iniciarse en el mundo de la IA.

segments.source: Learn to program in AI from scratch. We have prepared a customized roadmap to transform your Python skills in a short time, in a fun and less stressful way. The program is organized in several modules where we will challenge you in a practical way
segments.en: Learn to program in AI from scratch. We have prepared a customized roadmap to transform your Python skills in a short time, in a fun and less stressful way. The program is organized in several modules where we will challenge you in a practical way
segments.es: Aprende a programar en IA desde cero. Hemos preparado una hoja de ruta personalizada para transformar tus habilidades con Python en poco tiempo, de una forma divertida y menos estresante. El programa está organizado en varios módulos donde te desafiaremos de forma práctica.

segments.source: Learn the foundations of Data Science with this course that includes short explanatory videos of around 5 minutes each along with mental maps in text to learn more effectively, hands-on exercises and a project to learn by doing
segments.en: Learn the foundations of Data Science with this course that includes short explanatory videos of around 5 minutes each along with mental maps in text to learn more effectively, hands-on exercises and a project to learn by doing
segments.es: Aprende los fundamentos de la Ciencia de Datos con este curso que incluye breves vídeos explicativos de unos 5 minutos cada uno junto con mapas mentales en texto para aprender de forma más efectiva, ejercicios prácticos y un proyecto para aprender haciendo

segments.source: Where any future Data enthusiast comes to learn. Whether you are just starting out or have been in adjacent professions for years, here you will find peers, mentors and challenges to support and learn from. If you want to acquire skills in data and machine learning.
segments.en: Where any future Data enthusiast comes to learn. Whether you are just starting out or have been in adjacent professions for years, here you will find peers, mentors and challenges to support and learn from. If you want to acquire skills in data and machine learning.
segments.es: Donde cualquier futuro entusiasta de los datos viene a aprender. Ya sea que esté comenzando o haya estado en profesiones adyacentes durante años, aquí encontrará compañeros, mentores y desafíos para apoyar y de quienes aprender. Si quieres adquirir habilidades en datos y aprendizaje automático.

segments.source: Our community programme combines practical sessions, mentor support and a team project. It typically runs over 12 to 15 Saturdays, ending with a Demo Day. Each local team confirms its format, dates and requirements.
segments.en: Our community programme combines practical sessions, mentor support and a team project. It typically runs over 12 to 15 Saturdays, ending with a Demo Day. Each local team confirms its format, dates and requirements.
segments.es: AI Saturdays combina sesiones prácticas, acompañamiento de mentores y un proyecto en equipo. Suele desarrollarse durante 12 a 15 sábados y termina con un Demo Day para compartir lo aprendido. Cada comunidad confirma el formato, las fechas y los requisitos de su edición.
